messages:
opsbot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT ALERT — elevated function-call (fncall) error rate and GPU queue growth in us-west-2. Impact: customer request latency rising, increased retries. Paging @priya_sre and @dan_eng_oncall — please acknowledge.
priya_sre: on it. seeing spike in agent/tool invocations to rerank and run external tools. queuing time on workers up ~3x.
dan_eng_oncall: ack. pulling live metrics. any correlated deploys?
julia_support: multiple customers reporting failed tool responses and malformed structured JSON responses. ticket count up 12 in last 15m.
priya_sre: no deploys in last 30m. looks like a traffic pattern shift — many small sessions doing aggressive tool-calling + structured output.
dan_eng_oncall: confirming worker logs show sustained high KV cache churn and OOM retries for a subset of pods. attaching snippet:
```
WARN 03:21:12 worker-14 eviction: kv-cache-miss spike
ERROR 03:21:15 tool-invoke timeout tenant=acme-corp reqid=...
```
priya_sre: immediate mitigation plan proposal: 1) soft-gate tool/function calls across lower tiers (free/dev) 2) throttle structured JSON streaming for long outputs 3) raise per-tenant fncall rate limits temporarily. Need go/no-go.
tom_product: we should avoid breaking paid customers. can we target only free-tier and noisy tenants first?
max_customer_sre: hi — acme-corp is on a paid plan but reports failures. please include them in customer impact list.
priya_sre: agreed. plan: - apply tenant-tagged soft-gate: deny new fncall sessions for free-tier and limit fncall concurrency for non-SLA tenants - for paid tenants with errors, apply gentle token-bucket throttle (burst allowed but reduced steady-state) - disable structured JSON streaming for all tenants for 10m as quick CPU-saver (we'll keep simple text streaming)
dan_eng_oncall: I'm ready to flip the flags. I'll coordinate with @lee_deploybot to push config. We should also enable fallback to model-only responses for tool call failures.
lee_deploybot: starting config rollout: /deploy config fncall.softgate=true scope=tenancy:free,noise-rollout=10% -> rolling over infra. will post progress.
lee_deploybot: 03:25 roll 1/5 applied to edge pools (no regressions observed).
priya_sre: enabling structured-output fallback now: structured_streaming_allowed=false across clusters (will keep validation mode).
opsbot: ACTION LOG: priya_sre set structured_output_streaming=false at 2381235132
opsbot: ACTION LOG: lee_deploybot started softgate rollout at 2381235150
dan_eng_oncall: applying tenant-specific rate caps for noisy tenants: set fncall.qps=0.5 for tenant tags [noisy,free-tier].
julia_support: notifying affected customers: sending banner to free-tier. for paid customers: support is preparing personalized outreach for any failing paid tenants (max_customer_sre will coordinate).
max_customer_sre: sending note to acme-corp now: "We are applying temporary call-shaping to reduce error rates; you'll see reduced tool concurrency but improved stability. Our SREs will follow up."
tom_product: what about eval jobs or scheduled pipelines that might be impacted? we should whitelist infra-critical service accounts.
priya_sre: good call — whitelisting scheduled-pipelines and infra-health-check tenants. done.
dan_eng_oncall: early telemetry: CPU usage down 22% on worker pool, queue length back to acceptable range. error rate for fncall halved in 5m.
lee_deploybot: rollout 3/5 completed. no customer-facing errors introduced.
opsbot: INCIDENT UPDATE: soft mitigations applied; monitoring. Please continue to watch latency and error graphs.
julia_support: some paid tenants still have intermittent 503s when tool invocations fail-over to model-only path. Support team has queued a post-mortem notice draft for those customers.
priya_sre: next steps: - keep soft-gates for 20 minutes, then gradually relax if stable - create a short-lived quota bump option for customers needing higher fncall throughput (ops only) - schedule follow-up incident review and RCA.
dan_eng_oncall: will hold the oncall until we see 30m of stable metrics. handing a 15m check to @priya_sre.
lee_deploybot: final rollout 5/5 at 2381235290. all clusters updated.
opsbot: METRIC SNAPSHOT (2381235310): fncall error rate => 0.8x baseline, queue depth => 0.6x peak, CPU => -18% vs peak.
max_customer_sre: acme-corp confirmed improved behavior; they can retry now.
julia_support: pushing status to status.redwood.ai: "Partial tool/function calling restrictions in place to mitigate overload. Some users on non-paid tiers may see reduced tool availability."
priya_sre: debrief notes: immediate mitigation successful; cause appears to be emergent traffic pattern with heavy fanout tool calls from a handful of tenants. action items: - granular tenant rate limiting by default - adaptive fncall throttler based on worker queueing - better early alarms for KV cache churn - run a brittle prompt protection eval for tool-heavy flows
tom_product: assign owners and timeline in the follow-up doc pls. also include messaging template for customers when we do future soft-gates.
opsbot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (stabilized) at 2381235380 — mitigations remain in place in monitoring mode. Please file postmortem and link here.
